KIDNAP BLACKMAIL/EXTORTION

Call Handler's Actions Checklist

Please Provide The Caller With The Following, once complete use the Email to FIM/FCIM button.
A specialist officer will recall using the code word. If no code word is provided then no information should be given.
Tell them to come up with a credible cover story if they are questioned as to why their phone is engaged (ie speaking to the bank or a friend etc).
Explain to the caller they MUST maintain secrecy even to family and friends.
Keep a record of any calls received (times, dates, tel numbers).
Complete a 1471 enquiry after any calls if they have no identification facility on their phone.
Keep the phone line free for any further contact from the offenders/police.
Do not attempt to record any conversations as this may alert the offenders.
Advice the caller that any direct approach to them by the Police will be by plain clothes officers who will produce ID. This may cause a delay in our response.
If not already given, provide the caller with a secure contact number 0161 856 1884 to enable them to provide any further information should they be made aware of any, if there is no answer, please advise the caller to ring on 999.
Once all above actions have been completed, make HAC aware and ask that the call associated with this report is emailed to the FIM asap.
